scope: Thermotec families represented in Sheet1 plus the documented NuWrap XtraFlex family
rating_scale: 1 = low relevance, 3 = useful, 5 = primary strength; ratings guide discovery and are not compliance or performance certificates

families.name: NuWave Mass Loaded Vinyl Acoustic Barrier
families.primary_function: Add flexible surface mass to reduce airborne sound transmission in a designed wall, ceiling or floor system.
families.score_notes: Strong acoustic-barrier fit. Energy and sustainability are not its primary documented functions. Compliance depends on the complete construction.
questions: Is the noise airborne or impact noise?
What is the complete wall, floor or ceiling build-up?
Is there a target Rw/Rw+Ctr or consultant specification?
human_gates: Select grade only after system and target are known
Verify fire, NCC and BAL requirements for the complete construction
Product Rw is not the completed-system Rw

families.name: NuWave Acoustic Floor Underlay
families.primary_function: Improve floor impact-noise comfort beneath a compatible floor finish as part of a tested or engineered floor system.
families.score_notes: Purpose-led fit for floor impact noise. System performance and floor-finish compatibility require confirmation.
questions: What floor finish will be installed?
Is the concern impact noise, airborne noise, or both?
Is there a body-corporate or consultant target?
human_gates: Verify floor-finish compatibility
Confirm tested system or consultant requirement
Do not promise an installed-system result from a component claim

families.name: NuWave UV-treated Fence MLV
families.primary_function: A legacy/secondary-source NuWave MLV configuration described for UV-exposed acoustic fence applications.
families.score_notes: Potential outdoor acoustic fit, but current manufacturer identity, availability and system evidence must be confirmed.
questions: Is the barrier continuously exposed to weather and UV?
What noise source, fence height and line-of-sight condition apply?
Is current supply confirmed?
human_gates: Confirm current Thermotec product identity and availability
Engineering review of the complete fence/barrier
No BAL or fire claim without project evidence

families.name: NuWave 4-Zero Foil-faced MLV
families.primary_function: A secondary-source foil-faced NuWave MLV configuration; keep separate from 4-Zero pipe insulation.
families.score_notes: Acoustic-barrier relevance is plausible; current manufacturer evidence and exact fire-test context are pending.
questions: Why is a foil-faced configuration required?
What surface mass and construction are specified?
Is there a fire or project specification?
human_gates: Confirm current manufacturer technical data
Review the exact fire report and application
Do not confuse with Thermotec 4-Zero pipe insulation

families.name: NuWrap 5 Acoustic Pipe Lagging
families.primary_function: Flexible acoustic lagging for reducing noise breakout from pipes, ducts and building services.
families.score_notes: Strong services-noise fit. Thermal and compliance outcomes depend on the service and complete installed system.
questions: What service and pipe/duct size is involved?
Is the noise airborne breakout, vibration, or both?
Is the service internal, external, hot, cold or fire-rated?
human_gates: Confirm service temperature and diameter
Verify joints, penetrations and complete system
Check fire and project specification

families.name: NuWrap XtraFlex Acoustic Lagging
families.primary_function: Flexible acoustic lagging for pipes, ducts and services where conformability and installation access matter.
families.score_notes: High installation-practicality relevance where flexibility is documented; confirm exact product variant and system.
questions: Does access require a highly conformable lagging?
What service, size and temperature apply?
What acoustic target or consultant detail applies?
human_gates: Choose between NuWrap variants from current data
Confirm service conditions
Verify complete system and compliance

families.name: 4-Zero Fire Retardant Pipe Insulation
families.primary_function: Thermal insulation and condensation control for pipe services where the documented 4-Zero fire-performance context is relevant.
families.score_notes: Strong thermal-services fit. Compliance score means useful documented evidence, not automatic project compliance.
questions: What is the pipe outside diameter and service temperature?
What insulation thickness is required?
What exact fire or project clause applies?
human_gates: Select diameter and thickness from design
Retain exact fire-test context
Confirm condensation, exposure and project requirements

families.name: E-Flex ST Pipe Insulation
families.primary_function: Closed-cell elastomeric insulation for HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing and hot-water services up to the documented operating limit.
families.score_notes: Primary strength is thermal/condensation control with broad sizes and formats. Project compliance remains system-specific.
questions: What is the pipe outside diameter?
What fluid and operating temperature apply?
Is the installation indoors, outdoors or UV exposed?
Is tube, coil or self-seal preferred?
human_gates: Confirm thickness from thermal and condensation design
Use HT rather than ST where exposure/temperature requires it
No generic family R-value

families.name: E-Flex HT Solar Pipe Insulation
families.primary_function: EPDM pipe insulation for solar and higher-temperature, UV/weather-exposed services within documented limits.
families.score_notes: Strong fit for higher-temperature and exposed pipe services; verify actual temperature, weathering and protection.
questions: What are continuous and intermittent temperatures?
Will the insulation be outdoors or UV exposed?
What pipe diameter and thickness are required?
human_gates: Confirm documented temperature limit
Confirm weather/mechanical protection
Verify regulatory and system requirements

families.name: Rockwool Pipe Insulation
families.primary_function: Mineral-wool pipe insulation for industrial and high-temperature service applications within documented limits.
families.score_notes: Strong high-temperature thermal fit; density is not Rw and final performance depends on thickness and system.
questions: What is the maximum service temperature?
What pipe diameter and insulation thickness are specified?
What jacketing and environmental exposure apply?
human_gates: Confirm temperature and thickness
Select jacketing/protection
Do not interpret density as an acoustic rating

families.name: E-Therm Reflective Roof and Wall Insulation
families.primary_function: Reflective insulation for suitable roof and wall systems, particularly metal-roof and shed applications.
families.score_notes: Energy-efficiency relevance is high when correctly installed in a designed system. System R-values and condensation design need verification.
questions: Is this a roof, wall, shed or conditioned building?
What air spaces and roof/wall build-up are proposed?
What climate zone and condensation requirements apply?
human_gates: Verify system R-value, not just product layer
Check condensation and installation orientation
Confirm NCC and project specification

families.name: MaxTape FR Insulating Foam Tape
families.primary_function: Insulating foam tape used to finish compatible insulation systems, joints and fittings.
families.score_notes: An installation accessory rather than a stand-alone insulation solution; correct system compatibility matters.
questions: Which parent insulation system is being installed?
Is the tape for joints, fittings or repair?
Is a fire classification specified?
human_gates: Confirm compatibility with parent system
Verify current fire-classification evidence
Do not sell as stand-alone insulation

families.name: Maxflex Coil Pipe Insulation (identity unverified)
families.primary_function: Two legacy catalogue coil records requiring manufacturer identity verification before use.
families.score_notes: Not scored because the current product identity and technical source could not be verified.
questions: Can purchasing or Thermotec confirm the current family name?
Is this an E-Flex ST coil or a distinct product?
Is a current technical data sheet available?
human_gates: Do not recommend, quote or map specifications until identity is verified
Confirm both MPNs with manufacturer or purchasing records
